names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ερμάς, Πατρόβας, Λίνος, Γάιος και Φιλόλογος, Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 5 ноября ст. ст., «Святитель Лин, папа Римский, апостол от 70-ти, сщмч.», with the rank words and the see left off; the see is recorded as the office. The line itself gives the name in the genitive.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 5. новембар ст. ст., „Св. апостоли: Патров, Ерма, Лин, Гај и Филолог.“ — «Св. апостоли» left off, and the heading gives the five nothing but five bare names in the nominative, so the third of them is the whole of the form (section 6). It is the IDENTICAL STRING this folder already stores for `ru`, which is two calendars agreeing and not a duplicate; `sr-foldpred.mjs` reports it adds no new fold key. «of Rome» in the display name is the see both books give him.

feast.note: The name page also lists «4 января (70 ап.)», the synaxis of the Seventy Apostles, which is a synaxis and not a second feast; this folder renders on 5 ноября ст. ст. only.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 ноября ст. ст. — «Апп. от 70-ти Патрова , Ерма , Лина , Гаия , Филолога (I).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ερμάς, Πατρόβας, Λίνος, Γάιος και Φιλόλογος, Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 18.11.2025 (5. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. апостоли: Патров, Ерма, Лин, Гај и Филолог.“

attestations.note: The third name of the day’s second entry, an ENUMERATED COMPANY OF FIVE with no «и други» at the end, so all five folders take the same one heading, whole, with its closing full stop. URL year 2025. `types` AND `office` UNTOUCHED AND THIS IS THE ONE OF THE FIVE WHOSE SEE THE TWO BOOKS AGREE ON: «Лин у Риму (II Тим. 4, 21)», bishop in Rome, which is exactly the Bishop of Rome already in `office`, and the reference is correct as printed. «Св. апостоли» is the `apostle` and «Беху из седамдесет апостола» the Seventy; `hieromartyr` is this folder’s own from an earlier page and this entry neither repeats nor contradicts it — it says only that all five «преселише се у царство Христово». `dates` UNTOUCHED at the first century: no year at all. NO `locations`, NO `related` ROW: the other four and `peter-the-apostle` are all `related` here already and Peter is not named in this entry. NO FOLD: the `sr` form is the identical string this folder already stores in `ru`, and in any case folds to three letters, below the four the gate’s `nameKeys` requires. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: The century days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 5 ноября ст. ст., «Апп. от 70-ти Патрова , Ерма , Лина , Гаия , Филолога (I).». Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave this folder any year, so this is the first date it carries.
